newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain cuts key rate after inflation tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Spain cuts key rate after inflation tumbles.

text.p: The Bank of Spain Friday lowered a key interest rate for second time this year in what analysts considered a vote of confidence in the Spanish economy.

The central bank lowered its money market rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 5.75 percent one day after Spain reported that the annual inflation rate dropped to 2.5 percent in February from 2.9 percent in January.
